name: manual_20234c
claim: Before hand-editing any scripts/git/ or .githooks/ file in Perpetua-Tools (or AlphaClaw) to satisfy a 'fix everything on branch X' instruction, check scripts/git/guard-sync-manifest.sh's GUARD_PARITY_REQUIRED and GUARD_SYNC_GITHOOKS arrays first. Files listed there are canonical-managed from orama-system — PT's copy must stay a byte-identical mirror. Implement the fix in orama-system on its own branch, merge normally, then sync the mirror down; never hand-edit the downstream copy even when an explicit user instruction says 'same branch,' since that instruction is about the deliverable's home branch, not a license to fork canonical infrastructure.

decisions.notes: Hand-edited .githooks/pre-push and scripts/git/check-guard-sync-divergence.sh directly in PT's fix/ecc-overlay-idempotency-20260814 worktree before checking the manifest — both files turned out to be listed in GUARD_SYNC_EXECUTABLES/GUARD_SYNC_GITHOOKS. Caught via AskUserQuestion before committing; the real fix was redirected to orama-system PR 311 per a live multi-agent coordination-board ruling (GossipBus records 1339-1340, codex-primary-orchestrator). Reverted the PT hand-edits cleanly with git checkout --. ECC push-gate analysis 2026-08-14.
